examples.title: Measuring with a Ruler
examples.problem: Measure the length of a pen using a centimeter ruler.
steps: Place the tip of the pen at the 0 mark.
Look at where the other end of the pen reaches.
If it reaches the 14 mark, the length is 14 cm.

examples.title: Converting Units (cm to m)
examples.problem: If a piece of cloth is 200 cm long, how many meters is it?
steps: 200 cm means two groups of 100 cm.

examples.title: Choosing the Right Unit
examples.problem: Which unit is best to measure the distance between two cities: cm, m, or km?
steps: cm is for small things like a finger.
m is for things like a room.
km is for very long distances like roads.
